segments.name: Local media
segments.description: A digital-first subscription and marketing services company delivering local news, advertising and marketing solutions to communities and local advertisers.
segments.evidence: Lee Enterprises, Incorporated is a leading digital-first subscription and marketing services company committed to delivering high-quality, trusted, and deeply local news and information.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from subscribers for digital and print content, from local advertisers for print and digital advertising and marketing services, and from commercial printing, distribution and digital services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our primary revenue streams are derived from subscriptions, advertising, and digital marketing services.
